description: Union multiple input spaces into a single Space (their combined outer outline).
instructions:
Boolean UNION of every connected Space → one combined Space (the outer outline). Fuses adjacent or overlapping spaces back into a single footprint: abutting/touching spaces use an EXACT vector union (dissolves shared walls, straight edges); truly overlapping spaces fall back to a raster union whose tilted edges are lightly stair-stepped. Disjoint inputs collapse to their largest blob (a single Space can't carry separate islands).

TIP: wire several room Spaces in to get their combined footprint for area / boundary.
